Makaragus Library

Makaragus is an online library platform built to simplify access to books, articles, and educational content for users of all backgrounds. Designed with a clean and user-friendly interface, the platform offers categorized collections—such as fiction, non-fiction, and academic—to make browsing and discovery easy.The system features a digital borrowing system, where each loan is automatically recorded in the database, including book title, borrow date, and return date. Users can view their current loans, receive due date reminders, and access borrowing history through their personal account dashboard.With full database integration, Makaragus ensures that borrowing records are accurately stored and easily accessible—making library management simple, efficient, and digital.

⭐ Key Improvements

  • Digital Borrowing System: Allows users to borrow books and track return deadlines in real time.

  • Borrowing History: Users can view their full transaction records and plan future reads.

  • Book Categories: Organized by genre (Fiction, Non-fiction, Academic) for easy browsing.

  • User Dashboard: Personalized account page showing borrowing activity and alerts.
